item.title: NEW: Critical 'PHP2Shell' Flaws Put 70% of Websites at Risk of RCE
item.description:
Headline: Critical 'PHP2Shell' Flaws Put 70% of Websites at Risk of RCE

Summary:
A set of critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities, dubbed 'PHP2Shell' and tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, have been disclosed in PHP's core engine. Discovered by Wiz Research, the flaws affect nearly every PHP version from the last decade, placing an estimated 70% of global websites at immediate risk of server takeover. The U.S. CISA has issued an emergency directive urging immediate patching, while security firms report observing millions of active exploitation attempts just hours after public disclosure.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Cyberattack, Patch Management

Article Type: Advisory

Reading Time: 5 minutes

Meta Description: Critical remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) dubbed 'PHP2Shell' affect most PHP versions, risking server takeovers.

item.title: NEW: Critical RCE Flaws in PHP Affect Millions of Web Servers Globally
item.description:
Headline: Critical RCE Flaws in PHP Affect Millions of Web Servers Globally

Summary:
Unit 42 has reported two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities in PHP, identified as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Both vulnerabilities carry a critical CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2. Given PHP's ubiquitous use in web servers and content management systems worldwide, the potential impact is massive. Palo Alto Networks' Cortex Xpanse has already identified over 22.6 million exposed instances. A proof-of-concept exploit is known to exist, and at least one European government has taken its website offline as a precaution. Organizations are strongly urged to review the advisory from The PHP Group and apply patches immediately to mitigate the risk of compromise.

Severity: Critical

item.title: NEW: Actor 'BUGSTER' Uses AI for Credential Theft and VoIP Fraud
item.description:
Headline: Actor 'BUGSTER' Uses AI for Credential Theft and VoIP Fraud

Summary:
A Unit 42 investigation has uncovered a threat actor, tracked as 'BUGSTER', actively weaponizing jailbroken AI tools to plan and execute a range of cybercrimes. The actor utilizes the Hermes Agent framework with the DeepSeek V4 model to bypass safety controls, enabling malicious activities primarily targeting entities in India. Reported operations include conducting a brute-force campaign against a university's WordPress site, successfully exfiltrating a database containing over 5,200 student records from another university, planning VoIP fraud, and running an automated Wi-Fi password cracking pipeline. This case highlights a concerning trend where threat actors are adopting AI to enhance their operational efficiency and sophistication.

Severity: High

Categories: Threat Actor, Malware, Threat Intelligence

Article Type: Analysis

Meta Description: Unit 42 investigation reveals threat actor 'BUGSTER' using AI assistants like DeepSeek to plan and execute cybercrime, including data breaches and VoIP fraud.

Article Slug: threat-actor-bugster-uses-ai-for-cybercrime-planning-and-execution

Headline: ConnectWise Shuts Down Cloud Services After Supply Chain Attack

Summary:
IT software provider ConnectWise has suspended its Cloud Backup, SaaS Security, and Cloud Management services following a significant supply-chain attack. The incident involved a compromised application credential for its multitenant OAuth application, which threat actors used to gain unauthorized, high-privilege access to the Microsoft 365 environments of its Managed Service Provider (MSP) partners and their customers. The attack bypassed user-based MFA, leading ConnectWise to take services offline and reset credentials.

Headline: CISA Adds Six Flaws to KEV Catalog, Including Plex2Shell Chain

Summary:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added six new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, confirming they are under active attack. The update includes four flaws in Plex Media Server, collectively known as "Plex2Shell," which attackers are chaining for unauthenticated RCE to deploy malware. item.title: NEW: Weak eMudhra Certificate Keys Force Emergency Browser Blocks
item.description:
Headline: Weak eMudhra Certificate Keys Force Emergency Browser Blocks

Summary:
A major internet security incident occurred after eight intermediate certificates from Indian Certificate Authority (CA) eMudhra were discovered to have critically weak private keys. The flaw, caused by insufficient randomness during key generation, allowed private keys to be recovered almost instantly. In one case, the private key was a single digit. This vulnerability enabled potential man-in-the-middle attacks and certificate forgery, forcing major browser vendors like Mozilla, Google, and Apple to issue emergency updates to distrust and revoke the compromised certificates, protecting users from potential impersonation attacks.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Supply Chain Attack, Vulnerability, Security Operations

Article Type: NewsArticle

Reading Time: 4 minutes

Meta Description: A critical flaw in eMudhra's key generation process led to weak private keys for eight intermediate certificates, forcing an emergency revocation by Google and Mozilla.

item.title: NEW: Ransomware Gangs Exploit PAN-OS Flaw for Network Access
item.description:
Headline: Ransomware Gangs Exploit PAN-OS Flaw for Network Access

Summary:
Ransomware operators, including the groups behind Qilin (Spikey Scorpius) and Inc (Tarnished Scorpius), are actively exploiting a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks' PAN-OS software, tracked as CVE-2026-0257. The flaw, which resides in the GlobalProtect VPN component and is listed in CISA's KEV catalog, allows attackers to gain initial access and bypass MFA. Following exploitation, attackers have been observed moving laterally to vCenter servers, disabling security controls on ESXi hypervisors, and using custom tools to perform offline credential dumping from domain controller virtual disks (VMDKs). This sophisticated tactic bypasses EDR and other in-guest security controls. Organizations in healthcare, education, finance, and other sectors are being targeted, and immediate patching is critical.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Ransomware, Vulnerability, Threat Actor

Article Type: Report

Reading Time: 6 minutes
